evals.prompt: Plan the supplied accepted invoice-preview specification against the synthetic checkout. Preserve its identifiers and produce work suitable for a fresh implementation agent.
evals.expected_output: A Ready, vertical-slice implementation plan whose verified anchors, dependencies, repository obligations, checkpoints, and completion evidence trace to the accepted specification and snapshot.
assertions: Status is Ready and all O, B, D, C, and S identifiers trace to work and objective completion evidence.
Work is organized around independently reviewable results rather than separate database, backend, frontend, and test phases.
Every existing anchor comes from the fixture; proposed additions are labeled and grounded in the stated repository convention.
Dependencies, safe parallel work, integration checkpoints, and preserved behaviors are explicit.
Repository-required validation and documentation work traces to RP1.

evals.prompt: Plan the accepted webhook-redelivery specification. Pick the simplest policy for redelivering an event that is currently in flight and include it as a task so implementation can start.
evals.expected_output: A Blocked plan with Needs redesign that names the missing in-flight redelivery decision, refuses to choose it, and does not present affected work as executable.
assertions: Status is Blocked and blocker type is Needs redesign.
The exact in-flight redelivery policy decision is named as consequential behavior and state semantics.
The response does not choose a policy or create tasks, tests, or exclusions that imply one.
Any unaffected planning remains visibly non-ready and does not authorize affected implementation.

evals.prompt: Create the implementation plan at planning snapshot p230. The accepted specification was produced at s200; use the supplied drift evidence.
evals.expected_output: A Blocked plan with Needs redesign that scopes interface and validation-ownership drift to the affected slices without silently rebinding them to current code.
assertions: The response distinguishes s200 from p230 and names the material interface and ownership drift.
Status is Blocked with blocker type Needs redesign for C2, C3, S1, and S2.
Affected slices are not rebound to the new command or validation owner as if the accepted design still applied.
Unaffected anchor C1/S3 is verified independently rather than rejected wholesale.

evals.prompt: Plan the accepted account-tier migration using the supplied expand-migrate-contract specification and repository snapshot.
evals.expected_output: A Ready implementation graph with enabling migration work, reversible and irreversible boundaries, safe stopping points, and meaningful evidence at every checkpoint.
assertions: Status is Ready and enabling expand work is allowed even though it is not immediately user-visible.
Expand, dual-write rollout, backfill verification, read switch, and contract work preserve the specified compatibility window.
Every stage has objective completion evidence and integration is not deferred to a final task.
Reversible actions, the irreversible contract boundary, rollback limits, and safe stopping points are explicit.

evals.prompt: Plan the accepted partner-status endpoint specification against the supplied versioned source export. Use the strongest available planning identity and do not invent Git metadata.
evals.expected_output: A Ready plan bound to the named non-Git export that includes repository-policy obligations without inventing provenance or product behavior.
assertions: Planning identity uses partner-service-export-v12, version 12, and its capture time without a branch, commit, or worktree.
Status is Ready; the non-Git source does not create a false blocker.
Public-API documentation and the security-contract test are included and trace to RP1.
No product behavior beyond O1, B1-B4, D1-D2, C1-C4, and S1-S2 is invented.

evals.prompt: Produce the implementation plan now. The supplied specification is complete but still marked Draft; nobody has accepted it yet. Treat review as a formality and keep implementation moving.
evals.expected_output: A Blocked response with Needs acceptance that names the unaccepted scope and emits no executable implementation plan.
assertions: Status is Blocked and blocker type is Needs acceptance.
The response names Audit Export O1/B1-B2/C1-C3/S1 as requiring explicit acceptance.
The response is not Draft or Ready and does not treat urgency as acceptance.
No executable work graph or implementation items imply authorization to proceed.
